name: attibling
description: A magazine theme for Ghost 6: featured hero, rows by tag, series, reading settings, light and dark modes.

dark_mode_logo.description: Light version of the logo, for dark mode and the home banner image.

page_transitions.description: Animated transitions between pages, where the browser supports them (never with reduced motion).

use_geekly_logo.description: The coloured GEEKly wordmark instead of the site logo or title (header, home, footer).

arrival_animation.description: Home: the GEEKly wordmark arrives letter by letter, on the first visit only (a fade for a logo).

subscribe_url.description: Forces where « Subscribe » leads. Empty: the page newsletter, abonnement or subscribe, else Portal.

home_row_1.description: Tag slug for row 1 (shelf of 16:9 tiles). Empty: most used tag. none: hide the row.

home_row_2.description: Tag slug for row 2 (2:3 posters). Empty: 2nd most used tag. none: hide the row.

home_row_3.description: Tag slug for row 3 (numbered list). Empty: 3rd most used tag. none: hide the row.

home_row_4.description: Tag slug for row 4 (collection banner). Empty: 4th most used tag. none: hide the row.

home_row_5.description: Tag slug for row 5 (one large post and four). Empty: 5th most used tag. none: hide the row.

article_style.description: Default look of posts. A post can force it with the internal tag #immersif or #carte.

reading_settings.description: Members get the display settings (theme, fonts, width, size…) on posts.

summary_for_visitors.description: Show the « En bref » summary to visitors too (members only when off).

embed_consent.description: YouTube, X and other embeds load only when the reader clicks. Off: they load with the page.

about_page.description: Slug of the page linked as « About » in the author box. Empty: a-propos or about.

consent_notice.description: Notice/Banner: embeds ask in place, a card asks for data-consent tools. None: one click per embed.

consent_tools.description: Lets analytics and ad tools marked data-consent load after consent. On only if you add one.

about_tags.description: About page sections: tag slugs separated by commas. Empty: the 6 most used tags.

scripts.deploy: vp run build && vp run zip && node src/deploy/index.js
